visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins outdoors on a sidewalk lined with leafy green trees. A man with short black hair, wearing sunglasses, a white t-shirt, and an open black cardigan, is gesturing and talking to someone off-camera. In the background, there are parked scooters, a blue truck, and various storefronts with bright signs. (2) The scene shifts to the interior of a brightly lit supermarket. The man walks down an aisle lined with refrigerated shelves and colorful product packaging. He carries a small carton of eggs. The floor is tiled, and the lighting is even and bright. (3) The camera focuses on a refrigerated section filled with various milk and yogurt bottles. The man points at the price tags and then reaches for a blue and white milk carton. His facial expression is inquisitive as he talks. (4) The man continues through the snack aisle, surrounded by shelves of cereal, crackers, and canned goods. He picks up a yellow bottle of throat lozenges while holding his other purchases. (5) At the checkout counter, a cashier in a red uniform and face mask scans the items. The man stands across from him, holding his phone. Various point-of-sale displays and cigarette packs are visible behind the counter. (6) Back outdoors on the sidewalk, the man looks at a long paper receipt with a surprised expression. He holds the milk, eggs, and lozenges as he continues to talk, walking toward the camera.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio begins with a male voice speaking in a casual, conversational tone. There is a low-level urban background hum with distant traffic noise. (2) A transition occurs with a subtle digital UI sound effect as the man enters the store. The background shifts to a light, medium-tempo electronic BGM with a consistent synth beat. The man's voice is clearer, but supermarket room tone is audible. (3) A series of high-pitched electronic beeps (scanning sounds) interrupt the speech as the man reaches the checkout. The BGM continues steadily in the background. (4) The scene returns to the outdoor environment. The man's voice exhibits higher arousal and a humorous inflection as he reacts to the receipt. The urban noise floor returns, and the BGM swells slightly toward the end.

narrative_and_purpose.mainPurpose: The video is a humorous vlog exploring the concept of 'wealth freedom' in a relatable context. The creator attempts to shop at a common supermarket without looking at any prices to see if he can feel wealthy, only to be shocked by the total cost when checking the receipt at the end.
